title: Microsoft Unifies AI Division To End Copilot Confusion, Boost Growth - Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT)
summary: Microsoft is reshaping its AI leadership to streamline its product lineup and strengthen its position in the AI market, amidst pressure on its shares and competition from rivals.
sentiment_reason: The company's restructuring and focus on AI models development come at a time when it faces strong competition and its stock is under pressure, indicating negative sentiment.
